explanation: Her machine sprayed hot soapy water over dishes held in wire racks. She showed it at the 1893 World's Fair in Chicago, where it won an award.

claims.text: Josephine Cochrane patented a dishwashing machine in 1886.
Cochrane did not patent the washing machine, the vacuum cleaner or the refrigerator.
Cochrane is said to have built the machine because servants chipped her fine china.
Her machine sprayed hot soapy water over dishes held in wire compartments.
Cochrane's dishwasher was shown at the 1893 World's Columbian Exposition in Chicago and won an award.
